82.text:
Ibiziga by'ibinyabiziga bigendeshwa na
moteri n'ibya velomoteri kimwe n'ibya
romoruki zabyo bigomba kuba byambaye
inziga zihagwa zifite amano n'ubujyakuzimu
butari munsi ya milimetero imwe ku migongo
yabyo yose nubudodo bwabyo ntibugire ahantu
na hamwe bugaragara kandi ntibugire aho
byacitse bikomeye mu mpande zabyo ariko
ibyo ntibikurikizwa ku binyabiziga bikurikira:

options.a: ibinyabiziga bidapakiye kandi bitajya birenza umuvuduko wa km 25 mu isaha ahateganye
options.b: ibinyabiziga bya police bijya ahatarenga km 25 uvuye aho biba
options.c: A na B ni ibisubizo by'ukuri

187.text:
Niki ugomba gukora igihe uhagaze ku
muhanda igihe cy'ibihu?

options.b: Kureka amatara yo k,ubisikana na kamena-bihu akaguma yaka
options.c: Kureka amatara yo kubisikana akaguma yaka

215.text:
Umurongo ucagaguye wera mu muhanda
usobanura iki?

224.text:
Ugeze ahabereye impanuka yo mumuhanda
bwambere ugasanga abakomeretse bikomeye.
wakiriza icyarimwe amatara y'ibyerekezo
byombi, niki kindi ushobora gukora?

options.b: Guhagarika ibinyabiziga bindi no kubasaba ubufasha
options.c: A na b ni ibisubizo by'ukuri

226.text:
Wakoze impanuka yo mu muhanda ,  ni
ikihe cyangombwa polisi ishobora kugusaba
kucyerekana ?

options.b: Uruhusa rwa burundu rwo gutwara ikinyabiziga

229.text:
Icyapa gikoze mw'ishusho ya
mpandeshatu kimenyesha:

options.b: uburenganzira bwo gutambuka mbere mu yandi masangano y'umuhanda akwegereye
options.c: ibyago imbere mu masangano y'umuhanda ukwegereye
options.d: a na b ni ibisubizo by'ukuri

options.a: Ni meza kuko atuma ureba kure
options.b: Ni mabi kuko arakugarukira akaguhuma amaso

257.text:
Igihe umuyobozi w'inyamaswa, afite
inyamaswa idatuje, asaba ko ibinyabiziga
bihagarara:

258.text:
Iyo mu muhanda hashushanyijemo
umurongo wera ucagaguye, ntugomba

options.a: Ntugomba kujya mu kindi gice cy'umuhanda
options.b: Ushobora kujya mu kindi gice cy'umuhanda bibaye ngombwa

352.text:
Mpagaze mu murongo  wo guhagarara
umwanya muto
